layout.heading: What Is **an SMM Panel?**
layout.body:
An SMM panel is an online platform where users purchase social media marketing services in bulk, at low prices, through a single automated dashboard. Instead of spending months growing an account organically, users place targeted orders for followers, likes, views, watch time, or comments and receive results within minutes or hours.

Panels connect buyers to a backend network of service providers through APIs. When you place an order, the system routes it to the correct provider, processes delivery, and updates your dashboard in real time. You track everything live.

[SMMGen](/about-us) is one of the most established SMM panels operating today. Founded in 2018, we have served over 98121 active users globally and processed more than 108774260 individual orders across every major platform.

Resellers use panels like SMMGen to buy services at wholesale rates and sell to clients at a profit. Agencies use them to manage multiple accounts from one dashboard. Creators use them to build social proof quickly and accelerate organic reach.

layout.heading: Who **Uses SMMGen?**
layout.intro: SMMGen serves four main groups of users. Each group uses the panel differently, but all rely on the same core advantages: low prices, fast delivery, and consistent results.

cards.title: Content Creators and Influencers
cards.body: Creators use SMMGen to build social proof quickly. A higher follower count and stronger engagement rate push content to more people through platform algorithms. Early momentum on a new post or video can make the difference between staying invisible and going viral. Many creators buy a small initial boost on a new account to pass the credibility threshold. After that, organic growth often follows because the account looks established.

cards.title: Small Businesses and Brands
cards.body: New business pages often struggle to look credible without an existing follower base. SMMGen helps businesses launch with a professional presence. A page with 5,000 followers converts visitors at a higher rate than a page with 50, even if the product is identical. This is not a shortcut to business success. It is a tool for removing the perception barrier that stops potential customers from trusting a new brand online.

cards.title: Marketing Agencies
cards.body: Agencies use SMMGen to manage social media growth for multiple clients from one dashboard. Our API integration allows full automation. Agencies place bulk orders, track delivery in real time, and report results to clients without switching between tools. Visit our [SMM reseller panel page](/smm-reseller-panel) to see how agencies and account managers use our platform at scale.

cards.title: Resellers and Entrepreneurs
cards.body: SMMGen's most profitable use case is reselling. You buy services from us at wholesale prices and sell them to your own clients at a markup. You set your own prices. You manage your own customer relationships. SMMGen handles all delivery on the backend. Our SMM reseller panel gives you everything you need to run a social media service business. For those wanting a fully branded experience, our [white label SMM panel](/white-label-smm-panel) lets you operate under your own brand name. For high-volume buyers, our wholesale SMM panel pricing offers the deepest discounts available.

layout.heading: How **SMMGen Works — Step by Step**
layout.intro: Getting started takes less than five minutes. Here is the exact process from signup to your first completed order.

cards.title: Create Your Free Account
cards.body: Go to [smmgen.com/signup](https://my.smmgen.com/signup). Enter your email address and set a password. No credit card is required to create an account. Your dashboard is ready immediately after registration.

cards.title: Add Funds to Your Balance
cards.body: Log in and click "Add Funds." Choose your preferred payment method. SMMGen accepts PayPal, Visa, Mastercard, Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and other major cryptocurrencies, along with local payment options for users in multiple countries worldwide. The minimum deposit is kept low deliberately so new users can test services before committing to larger orders.

cards.title: Choose a Service
cards.body: Browse the service catalog by platform. Every service listing shows the price per 1,000 units, the minimum and maximum order size, the estimated start time, and the refill guarantee status. Filter by platform or service type to find exactly what you need.

cards.title: Place Your Order
cards.body: Select your package. Paste the public link to your profile or post. Confirm the order details and click "Submit." The system processes your order instantly. You do not need to be online for delivery to start.

cards.title: Track Your Results
cards.body: Every order appears in your dashboard with a live status update. You see when delivery starts, how many units have been delivered, and when the order completes. If any issue occurs, raise a support ticket directly from the dashboard. Most users see their first results arrive within 7 to 15 minutes of placing an order.
